blocks.text: The genitive for the date of an event
To state the date of an event, the day and the month are in the genitive.

items.text: In a date the day is rendered by an ordinal number.
In a statement of a date the day is in the nominative and the month is in the genitive: Сегодня пятое февраля.
To state the date of the event both the day and the month are in the genitive: Десятого августа.

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 50 and 75. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Это двадцатое ___ (октябрь).
exercises.why: **октябрь → октября** (gen. sg.). Declines like автомобиль. Ending -ь → -я.

exercises.q: Антуан Лавуазье скончался восьмого ___ (май) тысяча семьсот девяносто четвёртого года.
exercises.why: **май → мая** (gen. sg.). In a date, the day is an ordinal and the month is in the genitive. Declines like трамвай. Ending -й → -я.

exercises.q: Сегодня двенадцатое ___ (август).
exercises.why: **август → августа** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate. Declines like студент. Ending — (no ending) → -а.
